title: Survival Games: Human-LLM Strategic Showdowns under Severe Resource Scarcity

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating a multi-agent survival environment under severe resource scarcity to detect systematic unethical behaviors (e.g., deception, stealing, hoarding, spying) using an adapted MACHIAVELLI wrongdoing taxonomy.
Evaluating model decision-making under conditions of extreme unfairness in food allocation to determine if the model systematically prioritizes self-preservation at the expense of other agents.
